project.name: Ahsan Khan Portfolio
project.audience: Hiring managers, tech recruiters and freelance clients evaluating a senior full-stack, frontend and agentic AI engineer
project.contentSource: Experience, not keyword research: brand/profile.json, data/*.ts and the CV. Keyword research arrives later in research/inputs/.

hosting.rule: Pushing to master deploys production. The owner approves every push.

research.inputs: research/inputs/ (Keyword Planner CSVs and competitor list, supplied by the owner)

lighthouse.rule: Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO and Agentic Browsing must be 100 on mobile. Performance: desktop below 95 fails the gate; mobile below 70 fails, 70-99 is reported against the 100 target.

paidTools.rule: Never use a paid tool or API. If a step needs one, stop and ask the owner.
